parsedVerdict.reasoning: InMemoryTaskRepository is an infrastructure adapter that implements the domain-declared TaskRepository port. All of its responsibilities are persistence concerns: storing tasks in a Map (save), looking them up by id (findById), and running a query (findByProject). The filtering on projectId, status and assigneeId only carries out the query criteria passed in through TaskFilter. It works like a SQL WHERE clause and does not enforce business invariants, state transitions or policy decisions. No domain or application rules are misplaced in this file.
